title: Research Material Assessment v1 (research-material-assessment-v1)
description: Structural contract for the material-readiness report persisted at knowledge/research-material-assessment.json. It is NOT a model output: buildResearchMaterialAssessment (src/knowledge/assessment.ts:103) computes it from persisted artifacts, and `ask`, `next`, `prepare` and the Analysis→Research mode gate read it — mode.ts even throws USER_INPUT_REQUIRED from it. What is checked: the envelope the reuse rule compares (contract + contextHash), the verdict and per-stage sufficiency the callers print, the stats object `next` indexes into, and gaps with the fields that drive grouping and the printed next command (id, priority, reason, evidence, blocks, fillIn). What is deliberately NOT checked: that a gap's priority or blocks list is the right judgement for this project, that fillIn is a runnable command, that the counts match the filesystem, or that contextHash still describes the live inputs — the gap set, its priorities and the blocking-to-stage mapping are the module's deterministic reasoning and stay in assessment.ts. No ceilings on gaps/covered/boundaries and no minLength on the prose: a longer report is not a defect, and the area/confidence vocabularies grow with the tool, so they stay plain strings.
